nodes.name: lifecycle.rs
nodes.summary: Starts and stops a Wingman session (autonomous screen-observing agent loop), wiring up its message bus and shared session state, and tears down its native overlay windows on stop.

nodes.name: loop_runner.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the core Wingman observation loop that periodically captures screen state, builds observation prompts, and feeds them into the agent via the message bus until cancelled.

nodes.name: WingmanLoop
nodes.summary: Holds the runtime state (cancellation token, bus, ticker) driving a single Wingman observation loop instance.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that assembles the Wingman feature (native status bar, lifecycle, loop runner, monitor enumeration, observation building, and Windows-specific bar) into a single public surface.

nodes.name: monitors.rs
nodes.summary: Enumerates connected displays/monitors via the Tauri app handle so the Wingman bar can be positioned on the correct screen.

nodes.name: WingmanMonitorInfo
nodes.summary: Serializable description of a single monitor (position, size, scale factor) exposed to the frontend.

nodes.name: observation.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM-facing observation prompt text from mission/flow context and captures screenshots for the Wingman loop.

nodes.name: windows_bar.rs
nodes.summary: Windows-specific thin wrapper exposing show/hide/visibility controls for the native Wingman status bar window.

nodes.name: workspace.rs
nodes.summary: Defines SessionWorkspace, the sandbox model tracking a session's working directory, optional git worktree, and additional allow-listed directories, and enforces which filesystem paths a session may access.

nodes.name: DirectorySource
nodes.summary: Enum tagging why an additional directory was added to a workspace (user-added, tool-added, inherited, etc).

nodes.name: AdditionalDirectory
nodes.summary: Pairs an extra allowed directory path with its DirectorySource.

nodes.name: SessionWorkspace
nodes.summary: Core workspace sandbox for a session: working directory, optional worktree root, and additional allowed directories, with path-allowlist enforcement.

nodes.name: side_query.rs
nodes.summary: Utility for firing isolated, non-conversational "side" LLM queries (with optional structured/JSON output) used by summarization, title generation, memory extraction, and skill selection throughout the agent core.

nodes.name: SideQueryConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for a side query: model, system prompt, temperature, and optional structured-output schema.

nodes.name: StructuredOutput
nodes.summary: Describes an expected structured (tool-call-shaped) JSON output schema for a side query.

nodes.name: SideQueryResult
nodes.summary: Result of a side query: raw text and/or parsed structured JSON plus token usage.

nodes.name: SideQueryError
nodes.summary: Error type covering provider failures, empty responses, and structured-output parse failures for side queries.

nodes.name: read_file.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the agent's read_file tool: reads workspace files with offset/limit windows, truncation guidance, a small read-result cache, and special handling for embedded builtin skill files.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a builder-style API (with_router/with_scratchpad/with_readonly_extra_dir/with_workspace_state) to progressively configure the tool before use.

nodes.name: ReadCacheKey
nodes.summary: Cache key combining file path, offset, and limit for a prior read result.

nodes.name: ReadCacheEntry
nodes.summary: Cached read result: content hash, truncation state, and metadata used to detect unchanged re-reads.

nodes.name: ReadFileCache
nodes.summary: Bounded in-memory cache mapping ReadCacheKey to ReadCacheEntry to avoid redundant large file reads.

nodes.name: ReadFileTool
nodes.summary: The read_file tool implementation: resolves allowed roots, applies the cache, and formats file contents/truncation output for the LLM.

nodes.name: peekaboo_cli_tool_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Peekaboo desktop-automation CLI tool covering command allow-listing, managed-argument injection driven by DesktopConfig, and output formatting.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Initializes a Wingman session for a monitor/mission, registering it with shared state and spawning its background loop.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops a running Wingman session, cancelling its loop and cleaning up associated session state.

nodes.name: close_wingman_windows
nodes.summary: Closes any open Wingman overlay windows associated with a session.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Entry point that drives the Wingman loop until the cancellation token fires.

nodes.name: run_select_loop
nodes.summary: Repeatedly ticks the observation timer and reacts to bus/cancellation events; implemented in platform-specific variants selected via cfg.

nodes.name: observe
nodes.summary: Captures a screen observation and flow-awareness context for the current tick.

nodes.name: enqueue_observation
nodes.summary: Builds an observation prompt from captured content/screenshot and publishes it onto the outbound message bus for the agent to consume.

nodes.name: list_monitors
nodes.summary: Lists all available monitors with their geometry for Wingman bar placement.

nodes.name: build_observation_prompt
nodes.summary: Formats mission, flow-awareness context, and screenshot presence into an observation prompt string for the agent.

nodes.name: canonicalize_candidate
nodes.summary: Canonicalizes a candidate path, falling back to lexical normalization when the path does not yet exist on disk.

nodes.name: new_worktree_inheriting
nodes.summary: Creates a worktree-backed workspace that inherits the additional directories of a parent workspace.

nodes.name: effective_roots
nodes.summary: Computes the full set of root directories (working dir plus additional directories) a session is allowed to touch.

nodes.name: is_path_allowed
nodes.summary: Checks whether a candidate path falls within the workspace's effective roots or an explicit extra-allowed set.

nodes.name: add_directory
nodes.summary: Adds a new additional directory to the workspace's allow-list, tagged with its source.

nodes.name: remove_directory
nodes.summary: Removes a previously added additional directory from the workspace's allow-list.

nodes.name: default
nodes.summary: Provides default values for SideQueryConfig fields.

nodes.name: extract_tool_choice_override
nodes.summary: Derives a forced tool-choice override from the configured tool list when structured output is requested.

nodes.name: side_query
nodes.summary: Primary public entry point that runs a plain-text side query against a provider and returns the response.

nodes.name: side_query_typed
nodes.summary: Runs a side query against a provider with structured-output extraction, handling thinking-model quirks and empty-response fallbacks.

nodes.name: try_extract_result
nodes.summary: Attempts to extract a SideQueryResult from a provider response, validating structured output when expected.

nodes.name: extract_structured_from_response
nodes.summary: Pulls the structured JSON arguments out of a tool-call-shaped provider response.

nodes.name: structured_arguments_are_empty
nodes.summary: Checks whether extracted structured-output arguments are effectively empty.

nodes.name: build_structured_result
nodes.summary: Assembles a SideQueryResult from a response plus its parsed structured payload.

nodes.name: build_text_result
nodes.summary: Assembles a SideQueryResult from a plain-text response.

nodes.name: observe_thinking_model
nodes.summary: Applies special-cased handling for models that always emit thinking/reasoning content before their answer.

nodes.name: observe_always_on_thinking
nodes.summary: Detects whether a model is configured to always emit reasoning traces.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a new entry into the read-file cache, evicting as needed.

nodes.name: llm_description
nodes.summary: Produces the LLM-facing description text for the read_file tool.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON schema of parameters accepted by the read_file tool.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path for the read_file tool: validates the path, applies offset/limit, checks the cache, and returns formatted content.

nodes.name: head_truncate_with_guidance
nodes.summary: Truncates output to a line/byte budget from the head, appending guidance on how to read more.

nodes.name: format_file_unchanged_stub
nodes.summary: Formats a short stub response when a cached read shows the file is unchanged since the last read.

nodes.name: read_embedded_builtin_skill
nodes.summary: Reads a builtin skill file that is embedded in the binary rather than on disk, applying offset/limit.

nodes.name: embedded_builtin_skill_name
nodes.summary: Resolves the embedded skill name matching a given virtual path.

nodes.name: classify_read_action
nodes.summary: Classifies a read as full-read, truncated, or unchanged for telemetry/formatting purposes.
